notes: EDGE CASE: a new-development LAUNCH PARTY invite. It names a building and mentions previewing units, which risks being misread as COMING_SOON_DEVELOPMENT or DEVELOPMENT_INVENTORY. But the email is an invite to an event (date/time/venue/RSVP), not an inventory or pricing blast -> REAL_ESTATE_EVENT. Grade category + themes + confidence only. Lower confidence floor.

input.subject: RSVP: Launch Party for The Solaire — cocktails, tours & DJ | Aug 28
input.bodyText:
You're invited to the official Launch Party for The Solaire!

When: Thursday, August 28, 2026, 7:00-10:00 PM
Where: The Solaire Sales Gallery, 88 Kent Ave, Williamsburg

Come celebrate the launch with cocktails, a live DJ, and guided preview tours of the model residences. Meet the design team. Bring a colleague. Valet available.

Space is limited — please RSVP by Aug 22.

SERHANT. Events
